tool_selection: Cheapest suitable tool first: direct HTTP GET via urllib with a 25s timeout and 256KB body cap; a single curl alternative client was used only after two client-side TLS certificate failures. No browser, CAPTCHA solve, auth or paywall bypass was used.
tool_selection_reason: All selected surfaces expose HTML or JSON over public HTTP; a browser would add cost without adding evidence, and challenge pages were stopped rather than solved.
uncertainty: Search-engine totals are corpus-wide fuzzy matches; zero-result and challenged lanes are not proof that no relevant material exists. One specification index page carried an explicit AI-use restriction; no specification text from it was ingested.

conclusion: 25 new lanes probed beyond ACADEMIC_PROBES_V7.jsonl: 11 academic/archive lanes and 14 interoperability-specification lanes. No peer-reviewed ReactOS compatibility study was confirmed. Four academic HTML lanes returned challenge/verification pages at HTTP 200 and one returned a Cloudflare 403; all are recorded as no-evidence lanes with no bypass. One CORE title-level lead remains unverified after a 429 detail lane. Public Microsoft protocol pages, UEFI 2.11, ACPI 6.6, POSIX.1-2024, RFC 9293, WDK, ECMA-335 and Unicode 18.0.0 draft were indexed as requirement sources; PCI-SIG AI-use terms were recorded and no PCI-SIG spec text was ingested.
